nodes.title: Krea2 Character Sheet Designer / 使い方
widgets_values:
人物リファレンスは必須。構図はDesignerの文章のみで指示します。
UIのマネキン画像は表示専用で、生成へ接続されません。
画像1枚はVAE外観経路、画像を読むGroundedEncode、pixel pathへ接続済み。

モデル・LoRA・参照画像の仮名を手元のファイルへ変更して実行。
初期1696×768・5ビュー・10 steps / CFG 1 / euler / simple。
同じlatentをKSamplerとtarget_latentへ接続。高解像度は自動縮小しません。まず約1MP〜2MP以下から確認。
UIは7ビュー・8部位入力・Auto/Manual・日本語/英語対応。顔と全身のprofileは画面左向き。
静的検証のみ。実ComfyUIの読込、Queue、GPU品質は未検証。
専用ノード lbouaraba/comfyui-krea2edit と Identity Edit v1.2 LoRAが別途必要。Krea社公式のsheet workflowではありません。

nodes.title: Required: Identity Edit v1.2 LoRA / strength 1.0
Designer output dimensions / shared target latent

widgets_values:
Transform the reference image into one clean static character reference sheet on a pure white canvas.

Show exactly 5 separate depictions of the SAME character. Show only these selected views: front head-and-chest portrait; left-facing head-and-chest profile; full-body front view; left-facing full-body profile; full-body rear view.

Arrange all selected views side by side in ONE horizontal row, in the listed order.

Read the following approximate positions as composition guidance, never as text or lines to draw. Percentages run from the top-left of the canvas.

1. A straight front-facing head-and-chest portrait, with the complete hairstyle, head, neck, shoulders and upper chest visible. End at the chest; do not include the waist or legs. Region: left 3.2%, top 6.2%, width 19.8%, height 87.5%.

2. A strict side-profile head-and-chest portrait, with the nose pointing toward the LEFT EDGE OF THE CANVAS. Show the complete hairstyle through the upper chest, without the waist or legs. Region: left 24.6%, top 6.2%, width 19.8%, height 87.5%.

3. A straight front-facing full-body view. Face, shoulders, torso and feet face the viewer squarely, not in a three-quarter pose. Region: left 46.0%, top 6.2%, width 15.8%, height 87.5%.

4. A strict side-profile full-body view, with the nose and toes pointing toward the LEFT EDGE OF THE CANVAS, in the same screen direction as the profile portrait when selected. Region: left 63.5%, top 6.2%, width 15.8%, height 87.5%.

5. A straight full-body rear view. Head, torso and feet face directly away; show the back of the head without turning to reveal the face. Region: left 80.9%, top 6.2%, width 15.8%, height 87.5%.

The portraits have larger heads than the full-body figures. The portraits are chest-up, not additional full-body views.

All full-body figures stand neutrally at the same scale, arms relaxed, completely visible from the top of the hairstyle to the soles. Align the feet on one baseline. Keep clear white gaps and generous outer margins; do not overlap or crop any figure.

Preserve the facial identity, distinctive features, hairstyle, hair color, proportions, clothing, fabric colors, footwear, visible accessories and rendering medium from the character reference, except for the explicitly requested part changes. Keep anatomical left-right asymmetries consistent across views. Continue unseen surfaces simply and conservatively.

Do not add unrequested gloves, jewelry, props, accessories or costume elements absent from the character reference. Preserve reference gloves and footwear wherever visible unless explicitly changed by an applicable part directive.

Replace the original environment with a flat uniform pure white background. Use neutral soft diffuse lighting and natural shading on the character only. No scenery, floor texture, grid, cast shadows, extra figures, unselected views, inset panels, captions, borders, dividers or watermarks. Lettering or patterns explicitly requested by a part directive belong only on that part; otherwise preserve reference details without inventing new lettering.
